svg.desc: The binary user by movie matrix feeds three models: item-kNN (cosine similarity of item columns), EASE (closed-form item-to-item weights) and implicit ALS (user and item vectors). Each produces a score for every movie; movies that did not exist yet or were already rated are masked before taking the top 10.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Three collaborative models on one binary matrix

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Same input, same masking, same full-ranking evaluation; only the scoring rule differs.
